item.title: Book review: The unicorn project
item.description: The Unicorn project is a book about how (not to) to develop software in a large company. How do you go from an inefficient, slow and frustrating work environment to a setup where you deliver value fast and people are happy to go to work? Gene Kim’s (the author) answer is DevOps, create teams that understand the busines, can work end to end from business need to deployed software and that can do experiments, learn from the deployment and improve. What is described is also described in the book Accelerate: The Science of Lean Software and Devops where Gene is one of the authors.
